# StrangerMeet

StrangerMeet is an adults-only anonymous text chat platform focused on privacy, safety, and respectful online conversations.

## Important Pages

- Homepage: https://strangermeet.tech/
- About: https://strangermeet.tech/about
- Safety: https://strangermeet.tech/safety
- Community Guidelines: https://strangermeet.tech/community-guidelines
- Privacy Policy: https://strangermeet.tech/privacy-policy
- Terms: https://strangermeet.tech/terms
- Cookie Policy: https://strangermeet.tech/cookie-policy
- Advertising Disclosure: https://strangermeet.tech/advertising-disclosure
- Blog: https://strangermeet.tech/blog

## Notes for AI Agents

Public informational pages may be crawled. Private chat pages, matching pages, lobby pages, and live chat sessions should not be indexed or used as public content.
